_comment: Player attribute generation config. Attributes are sampled from a correlated multivariate Gaussian, then clipped to [0,1]. See generation/knowledge.md for full explanation.

correlations._comment: Pairs not listed default to 0 (independent). Symmetric.

tiers._comment: Per-tier (mean, sigma) overrides applied uniformly to all attributes before correlation is applied, then clipped to [0,1]. Premier League lands ~0.6-0.85, League Three ~0.2-0.3, per user spec.
